authority: Creator ruling 2026-10-28: a self-discard trigger can exile its own original suspended occurrence, without BOB intercepting the Suspension-to-Exile move.

contracts.name: Tombloom
contracts.printedParagraph: When Tombloom is discarded, exile it. A target Manifestation on the field gets -2 power until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Nghoul-ong, the Tormented
contracts.printedParagraph: If Nghoul-ong is discarded, you may exile it. If you do, you may play a target Ephemeral Will from your Limbo with a cost equal to or less than Nghoul-ong's base power without paying its Tribute cost until the end of the turn. If that Will would leave the Stack, exile it.
